interpretation: Access itself passed: HTTP range requests work and the archive exposes 1,496 CSV entries with 187 baseline files and participant/stimulus filenames. The preflight failed only because CSV files begin with metadata comment lines (first line '#Study_name,Study 6'), so the script never reached the actual column header. This is a parser/preflight-method failure, not evidence that the dataset lacks valence/physiology.
next_action: Freeze P0b outcome-blind header discovery that scans comment metadata only until the first non-comment CSV header, then stops before any data row.
